headline: EPS more than doubles sequentially and grows year-over-year
summary_short: Nintendo reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥127.88, up 127.2% q/q and up 55.0% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥127.88 rose 127.2% sequentially from ¥56.28 and 55.0% year-over-year from ¥82.48. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
